reason: Fit a side frame to the base, following the current goal.

reaction: It is satisfying to see the separate frame and winch come together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the winch brought the two assemblies together into a recognizable gantry.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second side frame was clear but repetitive after the first.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the results followed the goals and build reference.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each fitted a visible part, though the ratchet’s function was not explained.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue and see how the gantry lifts something, though this chapter’s guided fittings alone were fairly predictable.
